svg.aria-label: Legal RAG Bot drawn as one bench. A paper feeder (VBPL ingest) cuts legal documents into article and clause cards that fill a card catalogue (BM25), a pigeonhole rack (Chroma) and a pegboard of pegs joined by threads (the Neo4j legal graph). A carriage on rails carries the ranked cards (hybrid fusion and cross-encoder reranking) to a teleprinter with an antenna (the Groq LLM). Its draft answer goes under a magnifier (the citation verifier) before it returns to the terminal (the Streamlit UI).
svg.text: A question: 1 → 3 + 4 (search) → 6 (fuse, rerank) → 5 (graph) → 7 (answer) → 8 (check citations) → back to 1 · offline: 2 fills 3, 4, 5
